Pork Meat Deboner - Oudenaarde (05:15 - 13:15)

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.

Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.

PROFIEL

Your Responsibilities

• Deboning and processing pork products.

AANBOD

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Technical Customer Trainer who can step in and make an impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.
 

Your Role
 

 
• As a Technical Customer Trainer, you will be responsible for transferring technical knowledge to customers, workshops, fleets, and service partners. You will act as a key technical contact, ensuring that customers have the knowledge and tools needed to effectively use and maintain products and systems. 
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Training & Knowledge Transfer
 

 
• Deliver technical training programs to customers, service partners, and network organizations.
 
• Ensure accurate and effective transfer of technical product and system knowledge. 
 
• Develop new training programs that respond to market demands and customer needs.
 
• Create and maintain training-related system access and software credentials where required.
 
• Conduct on-site customer training sessions and technical presentations at customer events. 
 

Technical Support
 

 
• Provide technical support to aftermarket customers.
 
• Assist customers with technical questions related to products and systems.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for technical solutions and applications.  
 

Customer & Network Development
 

 
• Maintain strong relationships with service workshops, fleets, and industry partners. 
 
• Support the development and maintenance of commercial service networks.
 
• Identify training opportunities and emerging market needs. 

Your Profile:
 

Qualifications & Experience
 

 
• You must have experience providing technical training in the automotive sector.
 
• Strong technical knowledge of commercial vehicle systems and products.
 
• Extensive experience within the automotive commercial vehicle sector, particularly involving trucks, buses, trailers, and air brake systems. 
 
• Experience delivering technical training, coaching, or technical customer support. 
 
• Well-established network within the commercial vehicle service industry is considered an advantage.  
 

 
 

Language Skills
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written.
 
• Comfortable delivering training sessions to international audiences and expatriate teams.  
 

Personal Competencies
 

 
• Excellent presentation and communication skills.
 
• Passion for teaching and developing others.
 
• Customer-oriented and solution-focused mindset. 
 
• Highly motivated to learn and master new technologies and product portfolios.
 
• Flexible and willing to adapt to customer requirements and training locations. 
 
• Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an established investment management organisation based in Brussels, operating in an international and highly regulated environment. The offices are easily accessible and offer the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders on strategic compliance matters.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the compliance and risk framework
• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of new regulatory requirements
• Oversee AML/CFT activities and participate in related control and reporting processes
• Support interactions with regulators, supervisory authorities and regulatory filings
• Assess and monitor outsourced service providers and ICT-related risks
• Provide compliance support across fund operations, including investment monitoring and conflict assessments
• Participate in regulatory analyses supporting new jurisdictions, fundraising activities and cross-border operations

• Master's degree in Law, Finance or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Compliance position
• Experience within an AIFM, investment fund, private equity, venture capital, asset management or another regulated financial services organisation
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are valuable assets
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, compliance controls and risk management practices
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with multiple internal and external stakeholders

• Strong affinity for the watches industry
• Presentation and communication skills
• Client-driven, sense of service, attention to details

Our client is a leading financial institution with a strong footprint across Europe. With a sizable and dedicated workforce, they deliver high-quality financial services to thousands of customers throughout the continent. Their commitment to excellence and consistent service standards positions them as a true market leader.

Jobomschrijving

•  Execute and oversee the full audit cycle, including risk management and control assessment related to operational effectiveness, financial accuracy and regulatory compliance.
• Define the internal audit scope and develop annual audit plans.
• Collect, analyse and evaluate accounting documentation, previous audit reports, data sets and process flowcharts.
• Prepare and present clear reports reflecting audit results and process documentation.
• Identify gaps and propose actions to mitigate risk and reduce costs.

Our client is looking for an experienced Executive Assistant & Office Coordinator to support the Head of the Brussels office and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office.

 

Client Details

Our client is an international organisation based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Description

• Provide high-level executive support, including complex diary management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, expense management, and preparation of briefing materials.
• Organise internal and external meetings, seminars, lunches, and corporate events.
• Coordinate logistics for senior international stakeholders visiting Brussels.
• Manage office operations, facilities, suppliers, service providers, and administrative processes.
• Support financial administration, including invoice processing and document management.
• Assist with research, monitoring, and preparation of reports and presentations.
• Oversee visitor management and ensure compliance with office security procedures.
 

• Significant experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager within an international environment ; experience in an EU organisation is a big plus.
• Fluent English and French, both written and spoken. Additional European languages (German, Spanish, or Italian) are a plus.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office and strong administrative and organisational skills.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly discreet, with excellent interpersonal skills.
• Strong ability to manage priorities, anticipate needs, and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

Are you a highly organised and discreet Personal or Executive Assistant looking for a role where trust, flexibility and attention to detail are essential? Our client is a high-level private individual with several companies and international activities, looking for an experienced PA/EA to provide both professional and personal support.

 

This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys a high level of responsibility, varied priorities and working closely with a demanding but dynamic principal.

Your responsibilities as Executive and Personal Assistant

• Manage a complex and constantly changing agenda.
• Coordinate meetings, appointments and travel arrangements.
• Organise and accompany the client during international travel when required.
• Handle confidential information with a high level of discretion.
• Coordinate communication with internal and external contacts.
• Support the client with both professional and occasional personal matters.
• Follow up on various tasks, requests and projects across different businesses.
• Anticipate needs and ensure that everything is organised smoothly and efficiently.
• Act as a trusted point of contact and ensure excellent day-to-day support.

Your profile as Executive and Personal Assistant

• Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant or similar high-level support role.
• German is essential - you communicate confidently and naturally in German.
• Good command of English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Highly organised, flexible and solution-oriented.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Discreet and comfortable handling confidential matters.
• Able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and an unpredictable schedule.
• Willing and able to travel with the client when required.
• Mature, reliable and comfortable working independently.
• A service-minded personality with a strong sense of responsibility.

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. jobs.occupation: Medical Sales - Pharma Rx - Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a pharmaceutical company specializing in hormone therapies for women's and men's health. They develop and manufacture treatments for menopause, fertility, reproductive health, and testosterone deficiency. With operations in around 100 countries and a strong presence in Belgium, the company is recognized as a global leader in hormone-based medicines. Its expertise in trans dermal gel technologies has made several of its products widely used worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Medical Representative - Pharma Rx - Women health - Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Drive sales growth and increase market share for Women health products within the hospitals & private cabinets in Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant. 
• Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals, including gynecologists, urologists, endocrinologists, and other key stakeholders.
• Identify new business opportunities and expand product adoption among existing and prospective customers.
• Promote Women Health RX products awareness through participation in scientific meetings, congresses, exhibitions, and educational events.
• Collaborate with Key Opinion Leaders (Gynecologists, urologists & endocrinologists) to support training initiatives and strengthen disease and product awareness. 
• Maintain accurate CRM records and manage activities efficiently within budget.

As a successful Medical Representative - Pharma Rx - Women health - Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Degree in Science, Healthcare, Business, or a related field
• +3 years of experiences as Medical Representative selling Rx (products under prescription) 
• Strong understanding of the women's and men's health market and its key stakeholders is an asset 
• Strong communication & interpersonal skills 
• Strong commercial & negotiation skills 
• Fluent in Dutch & English
